description: This file contains unit tests for the buildbot_results module in the WebKit layout tests framework, specifically testing the BuildBotPrinter class and its methods for printing test results and unexpected results.

classes.name: BuildBotPrinterTests
classes.description: Unit test class for testing the BuildBotPrinter's output methods.

methods.name: assertNotEmpty
methods.description: Asserts that the given stream has non-empty output.

methods.name: get_printer
methods.description: Creates and returns a BuildBotPrinter instance along with its output stream.

methods.name: test_print_unexpected_results
methods.description: Tests printing of unexpected test results under various conditions.

methods.name: test_print_unexpected_results_fail_on_retry_also
methods.description: Tests printing of specific regression details related to crashes and timeouts.

methods.name: test_print_results
methods.description: Tests printing of detailed test results including regressions and pass/fail summaries.
